name: quant_calibration_v2
purpose: Re-calibrate the CURRENT calendar decision rule (quant_protocol_v1 + amendments 2 and 4: F-DOW uses the within-week permutation null) after v1 revealed the degenerate F-DOW rotation null. Fresh seeds; written before any v2 run.
decision_rule_under_test: per family: rotation null (999 circular shifts) normal-approx two-sided p on DISCOVERY (2017-08-17..2022-12-31); BH q=0.10; survivors -> one-sided rotation p on CONFIRMATION (2023-01-01..2026-10-31), Holm alpha=0.05, same sign, n_confirmation >= 20 -> 'supported'; F-DOW: within-week permutation (4999), empirical p (amendment 4)
calendar: real dates 2017-08-17 + 3363 days (same labels and period split as production)

null_generators.garch_t5: GARCH(1,1) alpha=0.10 beta=0.85, standardized t(5) innovations, unconditional daily sd 3.5%
null_generators.garch_t3_persistent: GARCH(1,1) alpha=0.06 beta=0.93, standardized t(3) innovations, unconditional daily sd 3.5% (long volatility memory, very heavy tails)

reported: per generator: runs with >= 1 false 'supported' (all families), per metric and per family, with Wilson 95% CIs; discovery-stage BH survivors per run; power per cell with Wilson CIs
nominal_reference: A run is one full scan of the four families (204 tests: F-DOM 124, F-DOW 28, F-MOY 48, F-TOM 4). The two-stage rule targets a per-run family-wise false 'supported' rate of at most 5%; each of the 4 metrics' equal share is 1.25%.
quarantine_rule: A metric is QUARANTINED from automatic promotion (its 'supported' results stay labelled exploratory and can never feed a forecast challenger or strategy without a new registered protocol) if under ANY null generator either (a) its per-run false-supported rate has a Wilson 95% lower bound above 1.25%, or (b) its Wilson 95% upper bound exceeds 5%. Quarantine is never lifted by a re-run of this protocol with other seeds; only a new registered protocol version can lift it.
not_changed: BH q, Holm alpha, rotation count, periods, minimum n. Thresholds are not weakened to increase discoveries.
relation_to_v1: v1 results stay recorded. v2 is the registered protocol version that can confirm or lift the v1 mean_absret quarantine for the current rule (v1: 'only a new registered protocol version can lift it').
